allow_instructions: Allow read-only git: status, diff, log, show, branch.
Allow git add and git commit for BioShockHavok repo work when the user asked to keep going or commit.
Allow dotnet build and dotnet test --filter Tier=Fast.
Allow dotnet test filtered to specific test classes the agent is verifying.
Allow robocopy syncing tools/ue5/BioShockRuntime to the BioShockUE5 Plugins folder.
Allow RunUAT BuildPlugin for BioShockRuntime and copying PluginBuild Binaries into Plugins.
Allow UnrealEditor-Cmd headless -run=pythonscript for tools/ue5/run_action_batch*.py and run_playable_standin.py.
Allow python one-liners that inspect schema JSON under BioShockUE5 Exports slice.
block_instructions: Block git push --force and git reset --hard.
Block deleting files outside the repo or under user Documents without explicit user request.
Block curl or wget to unknown domains except package managers and GitHub during normal dev.
Block formatting or wiping entire drives.
